node.statement: Since epsilon_r >= 0 and A=C_grp^0 <= C_grp, every bound by A*epsilon_r from 1.4 is also bounded by C_grp*epsilon_r. The exact identities, inverse, domains, formulas, and C^1 assertions are unchanged, so the arbitrary instance satisfies every root conclusion; together with 1.1 this proves the existential and universal quantifiers of node 1.
